tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Find directly bookable properties for a stay. Direct paths only — no OTA inventory is ever returned.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Cheapest direct quote for one property stay, taxes included, with the rail fee disclosed inside the quote.

tools.name: get_quote_multi
tools.description: Every direct source for a property, ranked cheapest-direct first.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Create a booking from a quote id. Requires a caller token AND a single-use human approval token (contract §5.4).

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel an existing booking. Requires a caller token.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Read a booking's current state. Requires a caller token.
